WITH selected_store AS (
  SELECT id FROM automation_os.stores WHERE shop_domain = $4 AND active = true
), stored_envelope AS (
  INSERT INTO automation_os.universal_event_envelopes (
    store_id, event_id, correlation_id, received_at, source_type, source_id,
    actor_id, store_domain, session_id, request_type, message, resource_type,
    resource_id, risk_level, execution_mode, identity_status, policy_status,
    envelope_status, payload
  )
  VALUES (
    (SELECT id FROM selected_store), $1, $2, $3::timestamptz, $5, $6,
    $7, $4, $8, $9, $10, $11, NULLIF($12,''),
    CAST($13 AS automation_os.universal_risk_level), $14, $15, $16,
    CAST($17 AS automation_os.universal_event_status), $18::jsonb
  )
  ON CONFLICT (correlation_id) DO UPDATE SET
    received_at = EXCLUDED.received_at,
    source_type = EXCLUDED.source_type,
    source_id = EXCLUDED.source_id,
    actor_id = EXCLUDED.actor_id,
    store_domain = EXCLUDED.store_domain,
    session_id = EXCLUDED.session_id,
    request_type = EXCLUDED.request_type,
    message = EXCLUDED.message,
    resource_type = EXCLUDED.resource_type,
    resource_id = EXCLUDED.resource_id,
    risk_level = EXCLUDED.risk_level,
    execution_mode = EXCLUDED.execution_mode,
    payload = EXCLUDED.payload
  RETURNING id, store_id, event_id, correlation_id, risk_level, envelope_status
), authority_audit AS (
  INSERT INTO automation_os.authority_audit_records (
    store_id, envelope_id, correlation_id, actor_id, authority_stage, decision, reason, evidence
  )
  SELECT store_id, id, correlation_id, $7, 'UNIVERSAL_EVENT_ENVELOPE',
    CASE WHEN store_id IS NULL THEN 'REVIEW' ELSE 'ACCEPTED' END,
    CASE WHEN store_id IS NULL THEN 'Store domain did not resolve to an active store' ELSE 'Envelope accepted for identity and policy evaluation' END,
    jsonb_build_object('source_type',$5,'request_type',$9,'execution_mode',$14)
  FROM stored_envelope
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  se.id AS envelope_id,
  se.store_id,
  se.event_id,
  se.correlation_id,
  se.risk_level,
  se.envelope_status,
  (se.store_id IS NOT NULL) AS store_resolved,
  (SELECT id FROM authority_audit LIMIT 1) AS authority_audit_id
FROM stored_envelope se;
